tools.name: compress_pdf
tools.description: Compress a PDF file to reduce its size. Renders pages and re-encodes as JPEG, iterating quality/resolution to hit a target size. tools.name: optimize_pdf
tools.description: Lossless PDF optimization: garbage collection, stream re-compression. No quality loss. Good for PDFs with redundant data; effect is small on already-optimized files. Free anonymous tier: 20 calls/day per IP, files up to 10MB. Larger files / more calls need an API key (https://ko-fi.com/yugutou/shop)

tools.name: inspect_pdf
tools.description: Inspect a PDF: page count, file size, password protection. Use before deciding how to process a PDF. Free anonymous tier: 20 calls/day per IP. More calls need an API key (https://ko-fi.com/yugutou/shop).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "inspect_pdf" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
